description: Open Coffee Lisbon is back, and this month we're gathering at ForkLore! These videos show the two routes from the street level to the venue. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/hpPwrXcwNpU https://www.youtube.com/shorts/l18Q649nl7Q Join us on September 29th for Lisbon's friendliest informal networking event. Whether you're an entrepreneur, a freelancer, a student, an expat, or simply someone who loves meeting interesting people, this is your chance to connect with the city's startup and business community. What is Open Coffee? It's an "un-meeting" — no speaker, no agenda, no formalities. Just people who want to help each other. Here's how it works: · We meet at 9:30 sharp · Everyone gets 1-2 minutes to share: · Who they are and what they're working on · What they need (a co-founder, a client, feedback, a mentor...) · How they can help others · After about an hour, the hosting stops and you're free to talk with the people who interest you most Why come? You might find a mentor, an investor, a client, a co-founder, an employer, or a new friend. You might just find the inspiration you've been looking for. Everyone is welcome — and we especially love first-timers. The details: · When: September 29th, 9:30 AM · Where: ForkLore · Cost: a minimum of 1 consumption at the bar. More than just coffee — join the ForkLore community Open Coffee is just one of the ways ForkLore brings people together. Throughout the week, we also host: · Acoustic Jam Session — every Monday 19h30 · Language Exchange — every Wednesday 19h30 · Board & Card Games — every Sunday 19h Come as you are. Listen if you're shy, speak if you're ready. Either way, you'll be glad to meet you. We start at 09:30 AM sharp. Everybody gets up to 2 minutes to present: 1. Who they are and what they are doing 2. What they want 3. How they can help others At 10:30 AM we stop hosting and you can talk to people who are most interesting to you. This event is based on the Open Coffee Krakow format, run by Richard Lucas and others in Krakow Poland since 2012. If you want to help and get involved in making this gathering a regular part of the Lisbon eco-system please let us know [here](https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9) https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9 if you are interested in knowing more about the Open Coffee format, take a look at our video for potential leaders [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z99E2z8anFU). We have events in Cambridge, Krakow, Ericeira, Sydney, Warsaw and soon Tirana according to our format, When you sign up to our events we add you to our [mailing list](https://lisboncommunityevents.substack.com/) https://lisboncommunityevents.substack.com so we can tell you about more free events run by volunteers . description: Join us for the **Open Coffee Lisbon Evening Social**—a relaxed, welcoming gathering designed for anyone in Lisbon’s vibrant startup and professional community who wants to connect beyond the usual business talk. Hosted by Richard and Naren and the friendly Open Coffee Lisbon team, this event is all about genuine conversations, new friendships, and building a supportive network in a laid-back atmosphere. description: We are back! ☀️💡 After 4 short months that flew by, we are back and we are here to stay! If you are an old friend from the Lightning talks we will be happy to see you and hear you again, if you just stumble upon our event come find out what the buzz is about! ⚡ Join us to share ideas, learn about odd topics / passions / curiosities, and meet interesting people. As always, the event is **free to attend**, but we appreciate RSVPs so that we can have adequate seating setup in advance of the event. The Lightning Talks format remains the same - anyone can sign up to give a talk, and will have **5 minutes** (strictly timed!) to talk about a topic of their choosing, followed by **5 minutes** of open questions from the audience. The only rule is no pitching of one's business - the ethos of this event is to inspire and educate, it is not a sales opportunity. Please respect this rule. We will have a projector as usual, for any visuals you would like to include in your talk. We want to encourage new people who have never given a talk to try presenting. The bar is low and it's a receptive audience and a great way to wade into public speaking. We are a friendly, and encouraging crowd. We appreciate challenging questions when rooted in genuine curiosity, in an atmosphere of kindness and respect. If you want to present **please add yourself to the lineup via [our Telegram](https://t.me/+ZB0vzNhg5MtjZjM0)** \- or post in the event chat here on Meetup and we will add you if there are spots available\. Planned schedule 19:00- Come early to socialize (or not, you do you) 19:30 - First round of talks 20:30 - Break 21:00 - Second round of talks 22:00 - Mingle and discuss over drinks/snacks Please note: the event is **free to attend** but lets share some love with our new venue that was so kind to receive us by buying a drink or something to eat. **About the venue** Absent Lisbon "Absent is an offline third space where you decide what time means, whether that’s reading for hours, working on creative projects, journaling, playing board games, drawing, having conversations, or simply disconnecting from screens.
